summary: Milestone 2 Module 9 (Owner Academic Intelligence) end-to-end PASS. Backend: tests/test_m2_insights.py 1/1 passed (1.89s); full regression suite 95 passed + 1 skipped (42.96s) across M1 + all M2 modules. Live /api/dashboard/academic verified against DB: baseline (empty window) returns overall_rate=null, 12 sections without homework, 12 without diary, latest_exam=null, staff all zero, trend array length matches window_days (14/30). Days clamp works (?days=200 -> window_days=60; ?days=3 -> window_days=7). Permissions: teacher -> 403, parent -> 403, greenfield owner cannot see sunrise sections (tenant isolation enforced). After seeding attendance (all absent for Class 1-A today) + 1 published homework via API, response reflects: today's trend rate=0.0, overall_rate=0.0, Class 1-A in lowest_sections at 0%, homework_published=1, sections_without_homework=11, cov row for Class 1-A shows homework=1. UI (390x844, Expo preview): owner@sunrise.demo -> Command Centre -> 'Academic insights' quick-insights row visible with ChartLineUp icon -> /academic-insights renders header 'Academic insights' with date range subtitle (e.g., '03 Oct 2026 – 16 Oct 2026'), segmented intel-window-14/intel-window-30 toggle (both visible, 30d toggle switches date subtitle to '17 Sept 2026 – 16 Oct 2026' and refetches), intel-att-overall Badge shows 'No data' baseline / '0% overall' after seed, intel-attendance-card renders trend bars for all 14 days (today bar highlighted after seed), 'Lowest attendance' section only renders when non-empty (intel-low-<id> rows appear after seed - verified intel-low-6ad09c1b1aad3ba7d4fb3a15 reads 'Class 1 - A 0%'), 'Frequently absent (3+ days)' block only renders when non-empty, intel-coverage-card shows '1 homework published' + '11 sections without homework' + '12 sections without diary' badges after seed, 12 intel-cov-<id> rows render (Class 1 - A '1 · 0d' with filled bar, others '0 · 0d'), intel-exam-card shows 'No published exam yet.' (no published exam in demo seed), intel-staff-card shows 'Punctuality —% · Late 0 · Absent 0 · Leave 0' and '0 leave request(s) pending' (no staff attendance in window). Principal@sunrise.demo also sees quick-insights and the page loads correctly. Teacher@sunrise.demo does NOT see quick-insights in Today screen; direct nav to /academic-insights renders ErrorState 'Couldn't load this - Your role (teacher) is not permitted to perform this action' with Retry button (403 handled gracefully). Regression on Command Centre: welcome-banner, stat-students(72), stat-teachers(29), stat-guardians(131), stat-sections(12), attendance-today-card, staff-today-card, guardian-verification-card, class-distribution-card all render. All quick actions (brand-studio, add-student, staff-attendance, leave-approvals, homework, diary, timetable, exams, insights, academics, people) visible and navigation to /homework, /diary, /timetable, /exams, /academics, /people succeeds. Recent activity list shows seeded homework publish + attendance submit events. TEST data cleaned up (attendance+homework deleted post-run).

issues: Minor: Line label is clipped at width 92px with numberOfLines=1 - 'Class 10 - A' / section labels fit for current demo but longer class names (e.g., 'Nursery - Red Group') could truncate. Low priority; current demo displays correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo web preview still logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' as cosmetic warnings (no behaviour impact). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Card/IconTile shadow usage). Carry-over from previous iterations.

action_items: (Optional carry-over) Migrate deprecated RN style props shadow*->boxShadow and remove props.pointerEvents in ui.tsx to clean up Expo web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_insights.py (~85 LOC) single endpoint scoped by need('dashboard.owner'). Days clamped max(7, min(days, 60)) - matches spec and test.

All figures derived live from DB: attendance trend/overall/lowest/chronic absentees computed from db.attendance records in window; coverage from db.homework (status=published, assigned_date>=start) + db.diary aggregate (grouped by section+date, deleted!=True); latest_exam picks newest published exam and reuses compute_results per section for consistency; staff aggregates from db.staff_attendance.
No MongoDB _id leak - exam id and student_ids are cast to str; sections list and labels use str(_id). No DRY issues (reuses today_ist from attendance and compute_results from exams).
Division-by-zero guards present (overall_rate=null if no records, punctuality=null if 0 present+late, pass_rate=null if 0 students, working_days_with_attendance falls back to 0 if None).
frequent_absentees threshold 3+ enforced in sorted comprehension, limited to top 5. Names resolved via a single db.students query - good.

Permission matrix matches spec: owner & principal roles granted dashboard.owner, teacher/parent 403 (verified live). Tenant isolation via ctx.school_id applied on every query - verified: greenfield owner response excludes sunrise sections.

academic-insights.tsx (~110 LOC): useQuery key ['academic-intel', school_id, days] - window toggle correctly invalidates & refetches. SkeletonList and ErrorState wire-up handles loading/error paths cleanly (teacher 403 shows ErrorState).

Trend bars gracefully handle null rates (3px placeholder in surfaceTertiary vs full-height brand bar). Conditional rendering of 'Lowest attendance'/'Frequently absent' blocks prevents empty-section rendering.
Coverage bars normalized by maxHw across all sections - visually meaningful; label 'Homework published · days with a diary entry' clarifies the two-number row.

quick-insights entry in command.tsx is gated by can('academic.manage') - owner/principal/admin see it, teacher/accountant do not. Matches backend permission (dashboard.owner is also typically granted to admin? verify: admin was not asked to test but command.tsx uses academic.manage which is wider than dashboard.owner; admin may see the link but get 403 on API if dashboard.owner is not granted). Not blocking - teacher UI already correctly hides and principal verified working.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testIDs render, window toggle refetches, after seeding attendance+homework the overall badge, lowest-section row and coverage row update, teacher gets ErrorState, principal/owner have access, command centre regression and all quick-action navigation OK)

seed_data_creation: Via API as admin@sunrise.demo + teacher@sunrise.demo: marked all students in Class 1-A (section 6ad09c1b1aad3ba7d4fb3a15) absent for today, and created 1 published TEST homework ('TEST intel ui', English, due today). Cleaned up post-run: db.attendance.delete_many({section_id,date:today}) removed 1 sheet + db.homework.delete_many({title:/^TEST /}) removed 1 doc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M2 Module 9 (Owner Academic Intelligence) is production-ready. Endpoint: GET /api/dashboard/academic?days=14|30 (need=dashboard.owner, days clamped 7..60). Response: {window_days, from, to, working_days_with_attendance, attendance{trend[{date,rate|null}], lowest_sections[{section_id,label,rate}], overall_rate|null, frequent_absentees[{student_id,name,absences}]}, coverage{sections[{section_id,label,homework,diary_days}], sections_without_homework, sections_without_diary, homework_published}, latest_exam{id,name,sections[{section_id,label,average|null,pass_rate|null}]}|null, staff{present,late,absent,half_day,on_leave,marked,punctuality|null}, leave_pending}. Frontend testIDs: quick-insights (Command Centre quick action), intel-window-14, intel-window-30 (Segmented), intel-attendance-card, intel-att-overall (Badge), intel-low-<section_id> (per lowest-section Line row - only renders if non-empty), intel-coverage-card, intel-no-hw (Badge, only when sections_without_homework>0), intel-cov-<section_id> (per section coverage Line row), intel-exam-card, intel-staff-card. Date range subtitle format: 'DD MMM YYYY – DD MMM YYYY'. Line label is clipped at width 92px with numberOfLines=1 (demo labels fit). ErrorState wired via q.isError (teacher/parent 403 -> 'Couldn't load this - Your role (<role>) is not permitted to perform this action').
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature works end-to-end. Minor observation: command.tsx gates quick-insights via can('academic.manage') while backend uses dashboard.owner permission. In the demo seed, owner/principal/admin all appear to have both; teacher correctly does not see the link. If a role were ever to have academic.manage but not dashboard.owner, the row would appear but the API would 403 (handled by ErrorState).
